I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #central-random. I noted the correction: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats. I also suggested he correct his earlier #central-team post so people there have the right number.

I didn't post in #central-team or change anything else, since he said no action was needed. Repeating the seat count in #central-random was fine for two reasons. Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures. And Tobias had already posted the number in that channel himself.
